integrity: General proof supplied, finite enumerations are corroboration only, numerical asymptotic checks do not replace proof; independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed finite fields; theta asymptotics for chains as n grows with q fixed; not an algebra isomorphism. Previous incidence regularity structure and binary total enumeration are credited; analogous theta limits could exist in unindexed literature.
title: Incidence-algebra regularity spectra and a discrete-theta law for triangular matrices
